workloads.description: Canonical distance-3 injection and cultivation circuit with circuit-level Pauli noise.

semantics.logical_work: Independently sample the complete circuit once per attempted shot and aggregate detector rejection plus observable-0 parity among survivors.
semantics.batch_semantics: A batch contains independent shots and changes throughput amortization only; every attempted shot remains one unit of logical work.

provenance.notes: Byte-for-byte copy; upstream records its origin as clifft-paper commit db7dc9f13a2c2854690e92390c779048a1ac1400.
